statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-27456 is a time-of-check to time-of-use race in the set-user-ID mount program when it sets up a loop device (https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-qq4x-vfq4-9h9g). It is fixed in util-linux 2.41.4 by commit f55f9906b4f6eeb2b4a4120317df9de935253c10 (loopdev: add LOOPDEV_FL_NOFOLLOW). The published Alpine 3.23 packages are 2.41.2-r0, which predates the fix, and 2.41.4-r0, 2.41.6-r0 and 2.41.6-r1, which are built from fixed upstream releases.

CVE-2026-27456 is a time-of-check to time-of-use race in the set-user-ID mount program when it sets up a loop device (https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-qq4x-vfq4-9h9g). It is fixed in util-linux 2.41.4 by commit f55f9906b4f6eeb2b4a4120317df9de935253c10 (loopdev: add LOOPDEV_FL_NOFOLLOW). The published Alpine 3.23 packages are 2.41.2-r0, which predates the fix, and 2.41.4-r0, 2.41.6-r0 and 2.41.6-r1, which are built from fixed upstream releases.

CVE-2026-27456 is a time-of-check to time-of-use race in the set-user-ID mount program when it sets up a loop device (https://github.com/util-linux/util-linux/security/advisories/GHSA-qq4x-vfq4-9h9g). Debian fixed it in 2.41.5-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6442-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-27456), which also carries the upstream loopdev change that opens the backing file without following symlinks. The DHI packages built from that Debian source carry the fix from the lowest published build in the current version scheme onward.
